scope: Supplemental sequential Node CPU; no renderer, GPU, FPS, real-time throughput, 120s wall-time or complete-tick budget claim

protocol.observer: paired off/on; external legacy query/full pipeline/native readback/bus timers always, extra bounded capture sub-timer on only
protocol.legacy: same existing physical fixture and query; stepAndQuery begins after composition admission and ends before collision capture
protocol.readback: real native numContacts/contactDist/contactImpulse readback, ground/anonymous filtered; no invented IDs
protocol.trackerAndComposition: capture elapsed minus native readback and synchronous bus publish; includes validation, episode update/drain and adapter overhead
protocol.diagnostics: only car candidates enumerated; obs-obs and sensor counter zero does not prove native absence
protocol.memory: forced-GC heap diagnostic if available; application-owned entity/subscription counts; exact WASM allocator memory unavailable
